spatial.png_origin: original y=0 at bottom; PNG scanline 0 is highest FITS y

spectral_metadata.method: Evaluate WCS on each actual plane; verify one-based PLANE entries; uniquely join wavelength AND bandwidth to cube table; compare full rows to official table. No row-number identity assumption.
spectral_metadata.comparison_tolerance: Exact equality of stored lookup and table values, no relaxed numerical tolerance
spectral_metadata.virtual_fourth_axis: Bandwidth world axis depends on cube axis 3; fourth pixel axis is degenerate, not time.

display.algorithm: One shared linear mapping; grayscale=round_to_even(255*clip((IMAGE-low)/(high-low),0,1)); alpha=255 only on visualization mask
display.bounds_source: NumPy linear-method percentiles 1 and 99 pooled over every eligible native pixel across all planes
display.interpretation: Display only; clipping and quantization do not change numerical data. Spectral brightness differences are not time variability or certified flux measurements.

flags.aggregation: Bitwise OR of selected propagated input flags, per official documentation
flags.unknown_bits: Reject affected pixels and disclose counts
flags.assessment_scope: Three mosaic-propagated flags only; absent source-level flags are not assumed good

regions.kind: sky-centered region using pixel-center membership, no fractional weights
